definitions.explanation: For wind to move or to expel air.

examples.japanese: {強|つよ}い{風|かぜ}が{吹|ふ}いて{帽子|ぼうし}が{飛|と}んだ。
examples.english: A strong wind blew and my hat flew off.

notes:
{吹|ふ}く describes blowing air or wind movement. It can be intransitive (wind blows) or transitive (to blow something).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Intransitive: {風|かぜ}が{吹|ふ}く (wind blows)
- Transitive: {笛|ふえ}を{吹|ふ}く (to play a flute)

ASPECT (ている):
{風|かぜ}が{吹|ふ}いている means the wind is currently blowing (ongoing action).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {風|かぜ}が{吹|ふ}く: wind blows
- {笛|ふえ}を{吹|ふ}く: to play the flute
- ラッパを{吹|ふ}く: to play the trumpet
- {息|いき}を{吹|ふ}きかける: to blow breath on
- シャボン{玉|だま}を{吹|ふ}く: to blow bubbles

NOTE: For wind instruments, {吹|ふ}く is the standard verb for "to play."
